build_model_parallel_roberta: build a model parallel RoBERTa model instance using build_model with args and task
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through ModelParallelRobertaModel with src_tokens and optional classification head
register_classification_head: register a new classification head on the model with a name and number of classes
build_lm_head: build a model parallel language modeling head with embed_dim, output_dim, and activation function
configure_large_architecture: configure the model parallel RoBERTa large architecture with 24 layers and 1024 embed dim
